hydrologic_nodes.name: Ohio River at John T. Myers Lock and Dam
hydrologic_nodes.notes: USACE Louisville District navigation lock/dam; pool elevation ~342 ft class per navigation tables; flood impacts include Uniontown levee context.

idnr_properties.name: Hovey Lake Fish & Wildlife Area
idnr_properties.flood_note: Entire property subject to Ohio/Wabash floodplain inundation; access may close during high water.
idnr_properties.access: SR 69 south of Mt. Vernon to Hovey Lake FWA entrance

idnr_properties.name: Twin Swamps Nature Preserve
idnr_properties.flood_note: River-bottom wetland community; one of few remaining Ohio–Wabash valley swamp remnants.
idnr_properties.access: West of Mt. Vernon via SR 69 to Hovey area; Raben Rd / Walls Rd parking

idnr_properties.name: Harmonie State Park
idnr_properties.notes: Wabash River corridor context north of Point Township; camping, trails, river access.
